summary: Iteration 3 testing complete for Pirate Radio Live's four new features: (1) follows, (2) in-app notifications via Livepeer webhook, (3) WebSocket chat, (4) Livepeer recordings/sessions. Ran 30 backend pytest tests (17 regression + 13 new) — 100% pass. Ran end-to-end Playwright UI test covering: register→dashboard (SessionList, follower-count=0, sessions-refresh button, notification-bell in navbar), bell dropdown opens/closes, sessions-refresh click succeeds, Browse filter-following chip only shows when logged-in and flips heading to FOLLOWING, Channel page shows follow-btn/chat-panel/chat-input/chat-send/session-list, FOLLOW ↔ FOLLOWING toggle works with follower count increment (7→8), WS chat connects (status=LIVE), sending a message persists across reload, own channel hides follow-btn, logged-out state shows chat-login-cta + follow-login-cta and hides filter-following chip. Every acceptance criterion in the review request passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — @app.on_event startup/shutdown remains deprecated (FastAPI recommends lifespan). Not blocking. Same note as iteration 2.

server.py follow endpoint swallows all exceptions with bare `except: pass` when insert fails (line ~554). Fine for the idempotent duplicate-key case (unique index) but could hide unrelated Mongo errors. Consider `except DuplicateKeyError` specifically.

server.py _notify_followers_of_live is called from both webhook and manual /go-live. If a broadcaster toggles go-live twice in a session, followers get duplicate notifications. Consider dedupe (e.g., only insert if no unread channel_live notification exists in last N minutes).
server.py chat WS accepts any authenticated user; no rate-limiting on messages. For MVP this is acceptable but should be tracked.
server.py file grew to 947 lines — approaching the >700-line split threshold. Consider extracting follows/notifications/chat/sessions into routers.
ChatPanel.jsx / SessionList.jsx use `.finally { setLoading(false) }` and try/catch but do not surface error UI to the user beyond a sonner toast — fine for MVP.
test_credentials: testdj@pirate.radio / testpass123 (existing broadcaster). Each pytest run creates one follower_<hex>@pirate.radio user + one test_<hex>@pirate.radio user via real Livepeer stream creation. UI run creates one uitest_<hex>@pirate.radio.
seed_data_creation: Per-run: 1 backend follower user, 1 backend register-fixture user, 1 UI test user. Each provisions a Livepeer stream (real API). Chat messages prefixed TEST_MSG_ / UITEST_ persist in db.chat_messages. Follows/notifications created for testdj channel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split across two files under /app/backend/tests/. Run `pytest backend/tests/ --asyncio-mode=auto`. test_new_features.py needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME env vars (conftest loads /app/backend/.env; frontend URL passed via env). Webhook simulation requires db.system._id='livepeer_webhook' shared_secret — will skip gracefully if missing. Each real Livepeer stream provisioning costs a Livepeer API call, so keep register-based tests lean. Recording sessions may be empty (list_sessions returns [] until real broadcasts are recorded). Frontend WS uses wss:// on same host — proxied through /api/ws/ path.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all four new features work end-to-end and all regression tests still pass.
